How reliable is a scoreboard match?

A scoreboard is a clue, not a controller ID. Documented pairings name a controller in a manual or arena report. Family comparisons show panels to inspect when the exact pairing is unresolved. A product specification does not prove what is currently installed at your rink. Video software and wired remotes have separate roles.
